description: A stylish, cozy Minecraft modpack designed with creativity in mind—perfect for building, decorating, and exploring without the chaos of magic or overpowered mobs
body:
🎨 Overview
StarStable Gangsters is a fun, relaxing modpack designed primarily for creativity and aesthetics. It focuses on building, decorating, and enjoying a visually appealing Minecraft world without introducing magic, super weapons, or overpowered mobs.

🌸 Key Features

Decor & Furniture Mods: Bring your builds to life with themed furniture, Fortnite-inspired decor, and realistic details.

Aesthetic Enhancements: Beautify your world with flower mods, decorative plants, and subtle visual improvements.

Creative-Friendly: No overpowered mobs or magic—pure fun for building, exploring, and social play.

Custom Style: A unique “girl-friendly” vibe, perfect for collaborative or solo creative sessions.

Lightweight & Stable: Optimized to run smoothly on most PCs without sacrificing visual charm.

💖 Why Download This Pack?
Whether you want to decorate, design, or just enjoy a visually pleasing Minecraft world, StarStable Gangsters provides the perfect environment. It’s ideal for casual players who enjoy aesthetics and creativity over combat or grind.
